title: São Filipe: Projecto de toponímia avança para associação de nomes às vias, largos e praças do município
why: Street naming and police numbering under way in São Filipe with Correios de Cabo Verde (underway).

title: Decreto-Lei n.º 47/2026 de 12 de outubro (Orgânica do MIHOT)
why: Ministry made responsible for policies on toponymy and addressing (national policy).

title: São Vicente: Correios de Cabo Verde vão apoiar actualização do projecto toponímico da ilha
why: Mindelo toponymy project updated with Correios; fund proposed for national toponymic structuring (underway, used by post).

title: Câmara Municipal da Praia instala placas toponímicas nos bairros da cidade
why: Praia installs first 100 street plaques; municipal toponymy platform available (in service in some cities).

title: Mosteiros e Correios assinam protocolo para modernizar toponímia municipal
why: Protocol to digitise street names and door numbers and integrate them into postal codes and address databases (used by post).

title: Praia: Autarquia lança plataforma digital para nomear ruas e casas
why: Praia municipal toponymy platform (Cityhub) launched 2 October 2025, not yet covering all neighbourhoods.

title: Deliberação n.º 26/AMP/2023 - Regulamento Municipal de Toponímia e Numeração de Polícia da Câmara Municipal da Praia
why: Praia municipal toponymy and police-numbering regulation approved (policy adopted).

title: Report of the Republic of Cape Verde
publisher: INGT / UN Group of Experts on Geographical Names
why: National toponymy commission supports massive municipal toponymy and police numbering (national policy).
